weakness.title: Improper Management of Physical Access Credentials
weakness.description: The facility does not adequately manage the issuing, tracking, use or withdrawal of the credentials that grant physical access.

extended_description.applicability: Credentials that grant physical access, such as badges, keys, codes and mobile credentials, from issue to withdrawal. The weakness lies in how credentials are managed, not in the entry control that they open.
extended_description.exploitation: An unauthorized person obtains, copies or keeps using a credential because it was issued without checks, is not tracked, can be duplicated, or remains valid when it should not.

row.details: Entry controls accept credentials held by persons who should not have them.
Unauthorized persons reach information, media and equipment.
Entries cannot be attributed to the person who was actually present, since credentials may be shared, copied or untraced.

row.description: Check identity and authorization before issuing a credential, and record who holds it.
Maintain a current record of issued credentials, including mechanical keys, and reconcile it periodically.
Give credentials an expiry date, or require periodic renewal.
Deactivate or recover a credential when its holder leaves, changes role or reports a loss.
Credential records identify persons and must be protected and retained in accordance with applicable law.

row.reference: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PE-2 Physical Access Authorizations
